# EAROS

> EAROS manufactures high-fidelity acoustic filters and hearing protection earplugs designed to reduce noise while preserving sound clarity and concert experience.

EAROS specializes in advanced hearing protection technology that combines noise reduction with audio fidelity. The company offers multiple product lines including EAROS ONE and EAROS SPORT, along with limited edition collaborations like the Hendrick Motorsports partnership. Founded by Ronnie Madra to address hearing loss and tinnitus prevention, EAROS serves recreational users, concert-goers, and sports enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- High-fidelity acoustic filters
- Noise Reduction Rating (NRR)
- Hearing protection earplugs
- EAROS ONE
- EAROS SPORT
- Noise-induced hearing loss
- Concert safety
- Tinnitus prevention
- Ear tips and replacement parts
- ANSI standards
- Hendrick Motorsports collaboration
- Acoustic filtering technology
- Customer support

## Products

- [EAROS ONE](https://earos.com/products/earos-one): Flagship high-fidelity hearing protection earplugs with advanced acoustic filtering
- [EAROS SPORT](https://earos.com/products/earos-sport): Specialized hearing protection designed for recreational and sports activities
- [EAROS x Hendrick Motorsports](https://earos.com/products/official-hendrick-motorsports-x-earos-tm): Limited edition collaboration combining EAROS technology with motorsports branding
- [All EAROS Products](https://earos.com/collections/all-earos): Complete product collection featuring all EAROS earplug variants and editions
